ports.note: Two layers is the floor, not the shape: comparison is across sources, so one layer has nothing to compare with.

ontology.note: The vocabulary follows EPIAI RECORDLINK in the epi-info-ai repository rather than inventing a second set of words: candidate, class, thresholds, decision. Every threshold the run used is asserted, and every pair that was not a non-match is named with its score, its distance and its name similarity.

changes.description: Two sources over one study area draw the same hospital twice, and a count of facilities is then wrong by however many of those there are. This compares records ACROSS sources and merges the pairs that agree, by the contracts of EPIAI RECORDLINK: blocking first, so pairs beyond a declared distance are never compared; binary contributions, so a similarity of 0.87 against a threshold of 0.88 contributes nothing rather than 0.87; and three classes rather than merge-or-not. A pair that passes both tests merges on its own. A pair that passes one WAITS FOR A PERSON and stays two records until somebody answers with a reason, which is pinned to a signature of the pair so that editing either record lapses the judgement. Missing never agrees with missing. Every threshold is a parameter and every parameter reaches the receipt. The review band is adjudicated in a dialog that shows both records side by side with every attribute each carries, the agreeing fields marked apart from the differing ones: the first version listed the pairs in the 292-pixel Inspector with two names and a distance, and the practitioner's answer was that it was unclear what was being adjudicated.

evidence.note: Jaro-Winkler is checked against the textbook values for martha/marhta and dwayne/duane, and the blocking, the three classes, the one-record-per-source rule and the lapsing of a decision are each pinned by a test. What is NOT established is the thresholds: the ones that ship are proposals, and what they should be is a measurement on the practitioner's own sources rather than a default worth trusting.
